coverage.complete_when: history_truncated is false and complete is true for the frozen interval (after_report_id, window_latest_report_id]

continuation_invariants: Every continuation repeats the first page's window_latest_report_id as through_report_id.
Bridge generation, nonce, retained-window bounds, and frozen high-water mark remain identical across pages.
next_after_report_id never decreases and advances exactly to the last returned report ID.
An empty nonterminal page is invalid.
Transport page size does not change canonical window bytes or digest.
security_invariants: Rejected calls disclose no report text, retained bounds, world identity, or world posture.
The method registers no mutation authority.
All strings, repeated fields, and total reply bytes are bounded.
The Rust decoder rejects duplicate fields, nonminimal varints, invalid UTF-8, cursor regressions, and noncanonical ordering.
acceptance: Credential rejection has neutral report posture.
Page sizes 1, 2, 7, 64, and 4096 reproduce one canonical window digest.
Reports appended after first-page high-water selection do not enter the frozen window.
Retained-history loss is explicit partial coverage.
Malformed, duplicate, reordered, oversized, and cursor-inconsistent replies fail closed.
Agent-facing output exposes retained bounds and grants no mutation capability.
